correctness.rationale: Chen multiplication yields the seven cubic coordinates exactly up to invertible diagonal scaling. The local base ideal is (b,(a+c)^3), so three successive simple blow-ups resolve the map and give D=3H-E1-E2-E3=-K. Exact Groebner elimination produces the nine displayed quadrics. The x0=1 chart reduces to x1*x4-x2^2, the x1=1 chart to x0*x3-(1+x2)^3, the x4=1 chart is symmetric, and x6=1 is an affine plane chart; hence the singular locus is exactly P and Q of types A1 and A2. The resolution intersection matrix independently matches the same Dynkin configuration. The bundled script reproduces these calculations over QQ.
